question: Which Excel tool helps prevent a specific cell from being edited?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Protect Sheet**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Protect Sheet** option in Excel allows users to lock specific cells, ranges, or the entire sheet to prevent unauthorized editing.
 
• When the Protect Sheet feature is enabled, users need to enter a password to make changes to protected areas of the worksheet.
 
• Users can specify permissions, such as allowing only certain actions like selecting locked/unlocked cells, formatting cells, or inserting rows.
 
• To use this feature, go to the "Review" tab in Excel and select "Protect Sheet," then set the desired restrictions and optionally add a password.
 
• This is a critical feature for safeguarding sensitive or important data in shared or collaborative environments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Conditional Formatting**

 
 
• This feature in Excel is used to format cells based on specific criteria or conditions.
 
• Examples include highlighting cells with a certain value, applying color scales, or using data bars to visualize trends.
 
• While useful for data visualization, it does not restrict editing or protect any cells.
 
 
 
• **Hide Rows/Columns**
 
 
• This function allows users to hide specific rows or columns in a worksheet, making them temporarily invisible.
 
• Hidden rows or columns can still be edited or unhidden by anyone with access to the file.
 
• This feature is often used to simplify data presentation but does not provide any security or editing restrictions.
 
 
 
• **Merge & Center**
 
 
• This feature combines two or more adjacent cells into one larger cell and centers the text within it.
 
• It is commonly used for improving the layout and appearance of data but has no role in protecting or restricting cells from being edited.
